purpose: Define pre-execution methodological acceptance criteria for NEXT3 after its repurposing as an identifiability study.

acceptance_criteria.requirement: The four structural transformation profiles must be deterministically distinguishable from the predecision representation and must not collapse to the same semantic profile.
The informative and controlled reassignment conditions must implement the declared action-to-profile mappings exactly, with balanced action/profile assignment.
The uninformative null must remove action-to-future correspondence while preserving the declared surface and presentation controls.
Successor state, realized transformation, T_acc, downstream state, outcome, value, reward, utility, performance, quality and success information must be unavailable to the decision mechanism.
An independently implemented reconstruction must reproduce the frozen semantic mappings, null construction, successor mapping and derived T_acc representation.
No acceptance-critical input may encode preference, reward, utility, task success, performance or quality.
Every primary decision input must be traceable to a declared design element, and every postdecision derived quantity must be traceable to the selected action and frozen mapping.
Given the frozen fixture inputs and identifiers, independent reconstruction must reproduce the same semantic mapping and successor/T_acc representations.

decision_rule.rule: NEXT3 methodological execution may proceed only if IAC1-IAC8 all pass.

non_claims: Passing these criteria does not establish the TGCV mechanism as true.
Passing these criteria does not establish causality.
Passing these criteria does not establish a value effect.
Passing these criteria does not determine a statistically sufficient replication count.
